Type: tall ladder-style bookcase
Use: storing books, displaying decor; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: wood with dark espresso finish
Colors: dark espresso brown
Shape: tall open frame with slightly tapered ladder sides, five shelves deeper at the bottom, horizontal side rungs, open back, medium visual weight
Feel: grounded, tidy, warm
Goes with: white or light grey walls, cream upholstery, patterned rugs, light wood floors; modern or transitional living rooms

product.name: 2L Lifestyle Hyder Wood Shelf Bookcase Tall, Brown
product.description: Designed with 5 wide shelves to offer ample room for storage Included anti-tilt safety feature fits securely to the wall and shelf Made of solid wood legs and MDF veneer with NC top finish Great for books storage or displaying decorative pieces Compact structure to fit in any small spaces(Dimension: 29.9” L x 15.9” W x 63” H)
